answer: Each agent identity is admitted by the forge contract only after a zero-knowledge SGX/TPM attestation binds its code hash and hardware key to the hollow state tree; jetty anchors each epoch's attestation root. A Sybil attacker must provision distinct, continuously monitored silicon and produce valid enclave proofs, while the quadratic bonding curve charges O(N^2) collateral for N identities; equivocation or duplicate hardware evidence irreversibly slashes the bond.
